limits.notes: max_depth: the outermost encoding has depth 1, an element is at depth 1 + its constructed ancestors; depth 65 is limit_exceeded. max_length: a length value above 2^64-1 (after stripping leading zero octets) is limit_exceeded; the number of length octets is not limited (up to 126, 8.1.3.5). max_tag_number: a tag number above 2^64-1 is limit_exceeded. The two large values are decimal strings because JSON numbers above 2^53 are not portable. OID arcs and INTEGER values have no limit.

policies.ber-shall-rules: ROADMAP policy row 1: BER decoding enforces the standard's shall value rules; used where the rejection is derived from a sender-side rule or from the definition of the type, not stated as a receiver rule
policies.der-noncanonical-reject: ROADMAP policy row 2: DER decoding rejects every non-canonical encoding of clauses 10 and 11; used where the clause does not name the type (constructed time types)
policies.limits: ROADMAP policy row 3: limits (nesting depth, length, tag number) are declared in this manifest; the standard sets none
policies.setof-duplicates: ROADMAP policy row 4: equal adjacent elements of a DER SET OF are accepted
policies.set-vs-setof: ROADMAP policy row 5: SET and SET OF share tag 0x31; the ordering check applies only when the caller names the type
policies.utctime-pivot: ROADMAP policy row 6: UTCTime takes a century pivot as a parameter; the case does not assert a century
policies.generalizedtime-x690: ROADMAP policy row 7: GeneralizedTime follows X.690 section 11.7 (fractions allowed, trailing zero not), not the RFC 5280 profile
policies.real-opaque: ROADMAP policy row 8: REAL contents are carried unchanged; no float conversion
policies.trailing-data: ROADMAP policy row 9: leftover input after the single top-level encoding is trailing_data
policies.unchecked-8bit-strings: ROADMAP policy row 10: Teletex, Videotex, Graphic and General strings are not alphabet-checked
